title: An observer or monitor never mutates the thing it observes
summary: A read-only observer stream is exactly that: an engine stays authoritative for snapshot production and control, while subscriptions carry only a read cursor. Mutation-shaped operations over an observation channel fail closed, not silently ignored. Observation never implies control.
evidence_note: Observation v0.2 contract: ObservationQueryRouter accepts only SNAPSHOT, CURRENT, BACK, HISTORY and KNOWN_STATE; mutation-shaped operations fail closed as OBSERVATION_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN. Virtual Browser Read me: 'Password inputs remain non-display evidence with no raw value in snapshot/history.'
invariants: A shared monitor cannot mutate either engine; actions still enter through the real control path.
Sensitive values (for example passwords) remain non-display evidence with no raw value in snapshot or history.
An observation subscription never becomes a transaction or control handle just because the reader is a model.
Resumable replay comes from an exact stream boundary, and the stream producer stays authoritative.
